## Owned Software (the category)
Found It coined and defined the category "Owned Software" (August 2026) as the opposite of SaaS:
- **Definition**: Owned software is business software the business owns outright: the code and the data. The business can keep running it, change it, or hand it to another builder without the original vendor's permission. If the software company disappears tomorrow, the software is still there, still running, still the owner's property.
- **The equation**: SaaS = rented software. Owned software = the opposite.
- **The test**: If you stop paying, what is left? Rented: a dead login. Owned: everything, still yours, still running.
- The category is bigger than one company: pay-once apps (e.g. 37signals) and self-hosted/open-source software are versions of it. Found It builds the bespoke version, one business at a time.
- Canonical pages: https://www.founditsoftware.com/owned-software (definition), https://www.founditsoftware.com/owned-software-vs-saas (comparison), https://www.founditsoftware.com/owned-software-test (the five-question test), https://www.founditsoftware.com/blog/what-is-owned-software (the manifesto).

## Core Services

### Found It OS — Custom AI Business Operating Systems (Flagship)
- Point of sale, inventory, customers, service tickets, and website with a built-in AI — one system, built for one business at a time, designed to improve lives and save time.
- The new system runs beside the old one, penny-matched nightly; the owner switches only when they say go. Zero downtime.
- Pricing: $3,000/month plus a one-time $2,000 migration & setup. Month-to-month, cancel anytime — and the system stays yours: the code and the data.
- The first twenty accounts signed at the $2,200 founding rate and are grandfathered forever.
- Nobody rents you your own business back. Clients own the code and the data — if we part ways, the system stays theirs.

### AI Search Optimization / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Get recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini.
- Entity authority, answer-engine optimization, structured-data dominance, and local SEO.
- Pricing: $1,500/month standard; $3,200/month premium and large markets.
- The only marketing service Found It still sells. Found It Software no longer takes new marketing clients for ads, web design, or social media.

### Custom App Development
- Native-feeling iOS and Android apps with in-person blueprinting and fixed-price timelines.
- Clients own 100% of the codebase and intellectual property.
